name: How do I choose a contractor for an attached garage addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for an attached garage addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for an attached garage addition, prioritize those with proven experience in similar projects and a strong local reputation. Look for contractors who are licensed, bonded, and insured in Nevada. Review their portfolios, check references, and read customer testimonials. Ensure they provide clear, detailed proposals, communicate effectively, and understand local building codes in areas like Las Vegas or Henderson. Simply Construction meets these criteria, offering transparency and quality craftsmanship.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience in garage additions, who is licensed, insured, has good references, and provides clear proposals.
